concerns: Escalation to U/V: contracts §4 U-1 makes only the original allowed GIMP toplevel fullscreen. Export Image and Export Image as PNG are separate toplevels: their titles/rectangles are redacted and their focus makes captures all black. X cannot locate or verify their save buttons via screen.look. U/V must agree a safe visible, focusable dialog capture/input contract before X10/X11 can test Review Focus 4 (deny leaves no file; approve writes PNG). These turns are blocked and do not claim consequential-card or export coverage.

X10/X11: ordinary fullscreen screenshots have vacuous:true and ok:false because there are no foreign pixels to inspect. This means missing mask evidence, not a leak. Require a controlled all-black capture (turn.mask or step.mask mode all-black), or a known full-frame fixture (mode fixture with pngBase64) before asserting ok. Excluded-focus captures must be all black. Summary-only screen.look cannot provide outside-target geometry.

Merged V (screen-tools.ts, computer-use.ts) never offers cu_begin to the model: a session starts with screen_look {goal, apps}, and the begin card's cu.begin item is hidden. V also rewrites helper refusals into English (cu-text.ts CU_MODEL_TEXT); fakevision maps those texts back to codes, and its tests read cu-text.ts.

Excluded turn (merged U session.go checkFocus): a terminal taking focus PAUSES the session (excluded-focus); V then holds every call in waitForResume until cu:resume/cu:stop. So criterion 4 is the pause plus no key in the audit (session.sh ends the turn with cu-stop), and the all-black evidence comes from the held look while a foreign NON-excluded window (foot --app-id cu-foreign-viewer) has focus: Capture blanks because the focused window is not allowed, without pausing.
